title: 2025 Benefits Overview (employee-facing one-pager)
content:
2025 Benefits Overview (One-pager)

Audience: Redwood Inference employees
Version: 1.0

What’s new in 2025
- Wellness stipend: $1,200/year (effective 2025-02-01)
- Mental health: 8 EAP therapy/coaching sessions per year (effective 2025-02-01)
- Parental leave: primary caregiver 16 weeks / secondary caregiver 8 weeks (effective 2025-03-01)

Notes
- No re-enrollment needed for the stipend; reimbursement process is unchanged.
- Mental health sessions booked via the same benefits portal (listed as "EAP sessions").
- If you are planning leave around the March 1 effective date, contact People Ops for confirmation.

Contact
- people-ops@redwoodinference.com
